03151 Yaziyz {yaw-zeez'}

與 02123 同源; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Jaziz 1; 1

雅悉 = "他使為顯著"
1) 一名夏甲人, 負責看管大衛的羊群 (#代上27:30|)
record.edic_text:
03151 Yaziyz {yaw-zeez'}

from the same as 02123;; n pr m

AV - Jaziz 1; 1

Jaziz = "He makes prominent"
1) a Hagarite, officer of David in charge of the flocks
